note: Marion County park on a Nickajack Lake embayment beside US 41 at Jasper, with gravel pull-through sites, a boat ramp, swimming and pavilions. Highway noise carries into the campground. --Claude
summary: Marion County Park (local, Nickajack Reservoir): county page confirms tent and RV camping, boat ramp, phone reservations (423-942-6653) but posts no rate; campers report $23 (latest 2026-05-26). Lakefront kept - shore-row pads 0.8-1.4 m above the water and ~13-32 m from it over open grass, site numbers not tied. Pin ~255 m off. Google 4.4 (1,087). Note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT stored 'lakefront' (not --AWH): kept. On Esri the angled pull-through rows run along the embayment shore; 3DEP puts pads at 193.6 m (35.02923,-85.56168), 193.58 m (35.02970,-85.56130) and 194.22 m (35.03010,-85.56098) against a 192.8 m water edge 13-32 m away over open mowed grass - passes the kayak test. Site numbers could not be tied to pads: no county site map; a camper on site 43 (2024-04-16) calls it 'right on the River'. The water is Nickajack Reservoir (Tennessee River), not a separate county lake.
PIN MOVE (~255 m): stored 35.03181,-85.56016 is an open field between the pond and the embayment; target 35.0297,-85.5613, the middle of the camping rows.

FEES not written: the county posts no rate. Campendium's latest camper-reported rate is $23 (reported 2026-05-26; also $23 on 2024-04-16 and 2023-10-01). The stored note's '$20/night' is older. A dated 2026 camper report could price it if the reviewer accepts the county page as having no rate.

HOOKUPS: stored water true / sewer true are derived from the old note and unconfirmed by the county; a 2026-08-26 camper says 'No sewer hookup site 31. Power, water' - so at least some sites lack sewer. No amperage found. Left as stored for the reviewer.
SITES: stored count 60 not confirmed on any page read.
